title: Advisor Workspace — choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Market Page direction. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Market Page
options.thesis: The shortlist read like a market listing: dense tabular figures, sector bars, and a footnote mark on every number.
options.viewport: Slate rail; the Thai north-star question as headline; listing grouped by action under reverse bars; SKU sheet on the right.
options.risk: If the density is set timidly, it collapses into a generic data table.

raised.raise: Each action group states its count against what the policy lets through, figures right-aligned tight to the margin.
Nothing is labeled twice: a figure appears once, and the sheet links to it rather than repeating it.
One fixed status ramp, identical in listing, sheet and rail.
Colour commits at region scale: the rail and sector bars are solid slate fields, not accents.
Hierarchy by type-scale contrast, not boxes: no card shells around groups.

options.label: Stock Card
options.lineage: Thai warehouse stock cards (บัตรคุมสินค้า)
options.thesis: Every SKU keeps its own card: each figure is derived line by line, with the balance carried down.
options.viewport: A card index of shortlisted SKUs on the left; the open card shows the derivation from sales to cover to verdict.
options.risk: Familiar to warehouse staff more than managers, and it can tip into a paperwork costume.

options.label: Dense Module Grid
options.thesis: SKU modules packed edge to edge, each with a small utility-red tab and hairline borders.
options.viewport: Multi-row nav rail; a mosaic of SKU modules under action tabs; detail opens in place.
options.case: Thai buyers live in dense marketplace screens, so audience fit is strong; a mosaic ranks less clearly than a listing.
options.risk: Ranks read weaker in a mosaic than in rows.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.thesis: Tracklist sides timed to fit the tape.
options.case: Merch managers do not identify with it, and handwriting weakens trust in figures.
options.kept: Hard capacity: every group states what fits, figures right-aligned to the margin.

options.label: Catalog Sleeve
options.thesis: Everything a catalog number; labels replaced by colour codes.
options.viewport: Black field, one plot, coded strip.
options.case: Coded labels fight the bilingual clarity this product needs.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Importance as dot magnitude on a coordinate field.
options.viewport: SKUs as stars on a field.
options.case: A rank is not a magnitude (INV-10), so the metaphor misleads.
options.kept: One fixed ramp used identically everywhere.

options.label: Guide Map
options.thesis: Areas as swelling lobes of flat colour.
options.case: Playful lobes undercut a decision record.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Letterforms carry everything; hierarchy by scale alone.
options.case: No product fact maps to font axes.
options.kept: Hierarchy by type-scale contrast, not boxes.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean light analytics app: left nav, filter bar, sortable table, detail drawer.
canonCard.viewport: Filters over a sortable shortlist table, with a right drawer for SKU detail and decisions.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any BI tool by design.
